-- HiveQL, not SQL Server or the browser workspace.
-- Prerequisite: configured Hive, HDFS access and an unused lab path.
-- Upload these headerless fictional rows to the lab directory first:
-- North,120.00
-- North,80.00
-- South,50.00
CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS studylab_hadoop_orders (
  region STRING, amount DECIMAL(10,2)
)
ROW FORMAT DELIMITED FIELDS TERMINATED BY ','
STORED AS TEXTFILE
LOCATION '/user/studylab/hadoop-lab/orders';
SELECT region, SUM(amount) AS revenue
FROM studylab_hadoop_orders
GROUP BY region
ORDER BY region;
-- Existing table metadata is not replaced by IF NOT EXISTS; inspect it first.
